subject: Hybrid interview logistics — May 18 (campus drop-off + virtual fallback)
body:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid interview logistics — May 18 (campus drop-off + virtual fallback)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to meet with us next Wednesday, May 18. Quick logistics so we’re all aligned:

- Schedule: On-site portion at Redwood HQ (Building 4, West Lobby) — check-in at 9:30am PT. First panel starts at 10:00am. The attached agenda has the exact panel times + interviewer names.
- Arrival: If you’re driving or taking rideshare, please use the West Lobby drop-off (see attached Campus_Map.png). We can arrange a short escort from the lobby to the interview room.
- Accessibility: If you need captioning or an ASL interpreter, let me know ASAP and we’ll book through our vendor. We can also keep a Zoom link as a backup in case travel is delayed.
- Virtual fallback: Zoom link (hosted by recruiting) will be available at the same times as the panels; passcode will be in the final confirmation.
- Reimbursement: If you take a rideshare from >20 miles away, we’ll reimburse up to $75 with receipt.

Attached: May18_SWE_Interview_Agenda.pdf, Panel_Roster.ics, Campus_Map.png

Please reply with any access needs or if you want the entire interview to be remote.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Recruiter — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

---

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@gmail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 09:27:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid interview logistics — May 18 (campus drop-off + virtual fallback)

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the details. A few items: 

1) Accessibility: I wear a hearing aid and prefer live verbatim captioning during interviews. I also use ASL interpretation for technical parts longer than 30 minutes; can you book both?
2) Travel: I’ll take a rideshare and should arrive ~9:20–9:30am. I have a small service dog who will be with me — is that OK for the escort?
3) Remote option: If possible I’d prefer the morning to be in-person; if there’s significant delay I’ll hop on Zoom. Please send the passcode.

Thanks — Samir
samir.shah@gmail.com | +1 (510) 555-9987

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid interview logistics — May 18 (campus drop-off + virtual fallback)

Jasmine —

Thanks for flagging. Quick operational notes: 
- I can cover the lobby escort the morning of May 18 (will meet the candidate at West Lobby by 9:25). Aditya, can you be available for a 10:00 start?
- Service dog: Facilities needs advance notice for seating; I’ll loop Facilities if you confirm.
- Captioning/ASL: Priya, can you coordinate ASL interpreter booking and live captions with Access Solutions? We need confirmation by Friday so we can include the interpreter in the calendar invite.

Laura
Director, Recruiting Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Access Solutions <access@captioning.co>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 10:32:45 -0700
Subject: Request: ASL interpreter + live captioning — May 18, 10:00–12:30 PT

Hi Access Solutions team —

We have a candidate, Samir Shah (samir.shah@gmail.com), interviewing on Wednesday 18 May. Requesting: 
- One ASL interpreter (in-person) for 10:00–12:30 PT (two 50-min panels + 20-min buffer).
- Live verbatim captioning (StreamText/Realtime) for the same window.
- Point of contact on the day: Jasmine Liu, +1 (415) 555-0127. Lobby escort will meet at West Lobby at 9:25am.

Please confirm availability and rates by EOD Friday and include any setup requirements (A/V, table placement, mic).

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@gmail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Access Solutions <access@captioning.co>, RideShare Concierge <concierge@rideshare.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: May 18 logistics (ASL, captions, rideshare reimbursement, Zoom fallback)

Team / Samir —

Quick consolidated update after vendor confirmation: 

- ASL interpreter: Access Solutions confirmed an in-person interpreter for 10:00–12:30 PT on May 18. They requested a small table near the interviewer circle and a lavalier mic for the candidate.
- Live captions: StreamText realtime captions will be available; we will project captions to the meeting room display and also share a StreamText link in the Zoom chat.
- Service dog: Facilities approved in-office access; Laura will escort Samir from West Lobby at 9:25.
- Rideshare reimbursement: RideShare Concierge, please process Samir’s reimbursement policy (up to $75 with receipt). Samir: after the interview, forward your receipt to concierge@rideshare.com with subject line "Reimbursement — Samir Shah — May18".
- Zoom fallback: Host link (recruiting): https://zoom.us/j/9998887770  Passcode: RW-5W8K. Please test audio/video a few minutes before your panel.
- Attachments: Final agenda (May18_SWE_Interview_Agenda.pdf), calendar invite (Panel_Roster.ics), campus map (Campus_Map.png).

Samir — please confirm if the mic/lavalier setup is OK and whether you’d prefer the interpreter to sit to the left or right of the panel (we’ll accommodate). If anything changes with travel, hop on the Zoom link above.

Thanks everyone —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Recruiter — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments (referenced): May18_SWE_Interview_Agenda.pdf (12KB stub), Panel_Roster.ics (2KB stub), Campus_Map.png (85KB stub)
